title: Broken Einstein Doll Ritual
description: A damaged, doll-like figure resembling Albert Einstein lies broken on the floor of a dark corner, its body cracked and limbs detached. The walls are covered in white chalk drawings including pentagrams, insects, the equation E=mc², and the words 'A RITUAL' and '666 SATAN'.
prompt: A surreal horror scene of a broken porcelain-like doll version of Albert Einstein with wild white hair and pink energy streaks, lying dismantled on the floor in a dark corner. Its jaw is open with white liquid dripping, one eye glowing green. The surrounding black walls are densely covered in white chalk occult symbols, pentagrams, insects, E=mc² equations, and the words A RITUAL and 666 SATAN. Cinematic lighting with glowing pink orbs in the background, gritty textured floor with scattered doll parts and wires.
